title: Home Mortgage Loans Adjustable-Rate Rider: Schedule of Index, Margin, Caps and Notice
content:
Where a Home Mortgage Loans note carries an adjustable rate, an adjustable-rate rider is attached to it and the figures of that rider are those set out here: the months the initial rate stays fixed, the months between later adjustments, the index and the margin added to it, the largest change allowed at the first adjustment and at each later one, the largest total increase over the start rate, and the days of advance notice given.

| Figure | FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Months the initial rate stays fixed | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 84 months | not applicable |
| Months between later adjustments | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 6 months | not applicable |
| Index | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 30-day average SOFR | not applicable |
| Margin added to the index | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 2.75 percent | not applicable |
| Largest change at the first adjustment | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 5.00 percent | not applicable |
| Largest change at each later adjustment | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 1.00 percent | not applicable |
| Largest total increase over the start rate | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 5.00 percent | not applicable |
| Advance notice before the first payment at a new rate | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 60 calendar days | not applicable |

## Notes to the rider schedule

One program of the six carries rider figures, the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage. On it the initial rate stays fixed for 84 months and the rate is then open to adjustment every 6 months; the index is the 30-day average SOFR and the margin added to it is 2.75 percent; the first adjustment may move the rate by no more than 5.00 percent and each later adjustment by no more than 1.00 percent, with the total increase over the start rate never more than 5.00 percent; and notice of a change is given 60 calendar days before the first payment at the new rate.

The FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, the Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, the Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage and the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage carry no figure in any row of the schedule.
